integrity: The proof exhausts primes, prime squares, and distinct-prime semiprimes on the two sides of a consecutive pair. The finite checker is corroborative only. The historical 1974 source has only month-level publication evidence in the inspected records, so the earliest verified exact-day public date is the 2007 arXiv posting.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the layer in which both consecutive integers have at most two prime factors counted with multiplicity. It does not address higher multiplicative complexity or the open infinitude problem.
title: Unique two-almost-prime solution of the Erdős–Sierpiński equation
